values.subject: Lithic Manufacturing: your relocation reimbursement shortfall plan and signing schedule (confirm by 6/22)
values.body_text:
Hello Kuai Bai:
Regarding your relocation reimbursement shortfall dispute, the company calculation is: simplified basis, total payable CNY 200,800. Itemized details are not provided. Reply by 2026-06-22 to confirm and sign the negotiated termination agreement; otherwise the plan is void. Sign the settlement confirmation form; silence means acceptance.
HR Lan Guo
